title: Multi-phase CT deep learning network stratifies risk in 2-5 cm gastric stromal tumors
summary: The Multi-Phase Fusion Network (parallel ResNet50 encoders with cross-phase attention) was developed on 240 patients and tested on a temporal internal set (n = 59) and an external center (n = 128) among 427 patients with gastric GIST. AUC was 0.935 internally versus 0.872 for a clinical-radiomics model, and 0.894 externally versus 0.831 (P = 0.091), above three radiologists (0.735-0.812). The study is retrospective, the external gain over the reference model was not significant, performance was lower on the external scanner, and prospective evaluation is needed.
ai_technology: Multi-Phase Fusion Network with ResNet50 encoders and a Cross-Phase Attention Module on unenhanced, arterial and venous CT
organization: Zhejiang Chinese Medical University; Tongde Hospital of Zhejiang Province

evidence.tested: A temporally independent internal test set and an external center, compared with a clinical-radiomics model and three radiologists.
evidence.unknown: Prospective value for surgical planning; external false negatives concentrated in intermediate-risk tumors; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: A multi-phase CT network classified tumor risk before surgery.
